title: Not Really Vanilla flavoured
description: This modpack improves the vanilla experience of the game while making it very easy for newbies, even if they never played vanilla!
body:
Have you ever found yourself thinking, "I want something that refreshes Minecraft, but without making too many changes to the game"? Or perhaps you're eager to introduce your friends to Minecraft in the best way possible. If so, then look no further, because this is the modpack for you!

NVF is a modpack that aims to enhance the vanilla experience. We've made some changes to the Minecraft UI, added a tutorial book, and now you can change your skin in-game too!

We've added more ruins to the game, cool-looking roads between villages, and cool bridges. With the 'Hold My Item' mod and some add-ons, the game feels more immersive than ever!
Tired of breaking grass when doing PvE or PvP? No problem! We've got you covered there too.
Worried about your FPS? No worries! We've added optimisation mods!
If you want to discover the other features, come and play our first alpha!
